scope: 45 Rust FFI helpers. Distinguish wire dependencies, delegated operations, and local projection or formatting arithmetic. Implementation and requirement statuses unchanged.
source_comparison: Frozen Temporal proposal via durable checklist rows. ECMA-262 remains requested authority.

review_timing.scope: Patch and evidence assembly after initial source/proposal review.

intentionally_excluded.286: Wire-only spelling differing from source-preserving proposal parser

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.2 steps 14–16: Decode wire ISO and clock fields for typed operations.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Bounded ISO and clock parts form a typed record with an exact combined subsecond field. Consumers perform semantic date and range checks.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.2 steps 10–16: Split subsecond fields for the ISO wire record.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Local projection. Integer division and remainder unpack the validated subsecond field into millisecond, microsecond, and nanosecond transport fields. Existing date and clock fields are copied.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §8.5.1 step 1: Carry exact decimal-string nanoseconds to the range check.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Decimal string requests decode straight to i128. The separate Number path accepts already represented integral values and cannot recover precision lost before it arrived. Instant bounds are checked by the typed caller.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §8.5.1 step 1: Delegate Instant range validation after wire decode.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Decodes the transport integer, then calls Instant::from_epoch_nanoseconds for exact validity.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §8.3.11 step 6: Decode an already resolved rounding mode.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Parses a normalized rounding-mode string into the typed enum. Property access, coercion and defaults are handled before the boundary.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §13.16 steps 1–5, 7–10 and 12: Decode normalized string precision.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Transports normalized Precision values as auto, minute, or a numeric digit count. Unit-to-precision selection and final range checks are outside the decoder.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.26 step 2: Select the compiled or arithmetic calendar registry.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated provider setup. Build configuration picks compiled providers or the arithmetic registry. Calendar lookup and chronology remain in their owners.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.26 step 2: Cache the native calendar provider registry.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Provider transport. OnceLock preserves the selected construction result, including failure, for the duration of the process.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.10 step 4: Resolve normalized calendar IDs for native requests.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. ISO resolves directly without a registry call; the registry handles remaining IDs, aliases and unavailable table providers.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §13.36 steps 2.a–2.c: Route the calendar annotation or ISO default.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Reads an annotation when present and resolves that key or ISO by default. Callers own full input parsing and the JS coercion contract.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.9 step 3: Select the configured named-zone provider.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Provider transport. Selects the compiled or empty-record registry at build time. Named zone availability and offset evaluation each have separate owners.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §13.42 steps 2–3: Serialize date fields and month code for the wire.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Local formatting. Copies provider date fields and renders a zero-padded month code with a leap suffix where present. Receives an already computed Date.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §13.6 steps 2–3: Decode resolved overflow policy.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Maps normalized constrain or reject to the calendar enum. The caller handles JS option access, checks and defaulting.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.12 steps 1–2: Resolve month fields and delegate epoch-day conversion.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Mixed. Decodes monthCode and checks its consistency with numbered month. Provider owns month lookup and conversion/regulation of the date. This is an extended wire operation.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.22 step 1.b: Narrow normalized date fields for provider regulation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Finite integral Number fields clamp to i32 bounds for constrain or reject an unrepresentable value. Calendar-specific field bounds and rejection live in the provider.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.22 step 1.b: Decode a wire Number before date field regulation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Extracts the normalized Number and selects the typed narrowing path from the resolved overflow value.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.26 steps 1.b and 2: Serialize projected properties and field errors.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Turns date/values/error bitmap into data and property-specific error arrays; absence of a calendar result is preserved as errors on date fields.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.26 steps 1.b and 2: Assemble a calendar property snapshot.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Mixed. Delegates extended calendar projection, months, month lengths, year starts and era. Computes the weekday, ISO week/year and selected length-derived fields locally. Mapping covers projection scaffolding and preserves provider premises.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.12 steps 1–2: Decode prepared date fields for typed resolution.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Preserves absent properties and decodes numeric, month-code and era data. Clamps optional month/day when allowed for narrowing. Calendar field resolution belongs to consumers.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §5.5.5 step 2 and §4.5.8 steps 1.a–1.f and 2.b: Decode and regulate present clock fields.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Local partial regulation. Applies clock bounds only to fields present on normalized input, preserving absent fields for typed merge. No JS option or property sequencing claim.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.31 steps 23 and 25–26: Dispatch prepared with requests to typed owners.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Rebuilds the typed inputs for five with operations. The zoned branch decodes an optional exact offset and passes typed field/update options to ZonedDateTime::with_fields. Other branches delegate to their corresponding typed owners.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.2 steps 7–13: Copy exact clock parts into a wire snapshot.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Local projection. Gets the six clock parts from exact local nanoseconds and places them in the corresponding transport positions.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.26 step 2: Preserve a calendar projection failure in the snapshot.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Turns an absent projection into errors for calendar fields while leaving later clock and zoned fields writable.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.5.3 steps 4–6: Decode a typed zoned value before snapshot projection.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Handles slot-style or operation-style wire shape and calls zoned_value_snapshot with exact instant plus selected calendar and zone providers.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.6 steps 1–9: Format an exact offset with optional seconds and fraction.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Local formatting. Emits sign and hours/minutes, adds seconds when required, and trims trailing fraction zeroes while preserving all significant nanoseconds. Scope is the bounded provider offset.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.10 steps 1–3 and §6.3.29 step 3: Project exact zoned snapshot fields.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Mixed. Adds one exact offset to the instant, emits local calendar and clock data, and records offset representations. Hours-in-day remains the typed owner with independent error transport.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.26 steps 1.b and 2: Route a bounded calendar snapshot request.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Checks configured epoch-day transport range, calls calendar_snapshot and adds optional clock fields. Range condition belongs to this wire request shape, not the public getter.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §12.3.12 step 2, §12.3.26 step 2 and §12.3.9 step 4: Route calendar conversions and difference.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Dispatches normalized calendar fields and anchors to typed conversion, projection and date arithmetic owners, including the date-until branch. Auxiliary wire endpoints have no inferred normative status.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.9 step 3 and §11.1.13 step 3.a: Dispatch native offset and candidate requests.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Mixed. Delegates offset lookup and candidate visits. Performs exact candidate deduplication and sorting for output. Provider range premises and throwing on a mixed invalid set remain outside the claim.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §13.10 steps 2–5: Decode normalized calendar name display mode.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Maps four resolved strings to the typed enum. The JS getter/coercion and default selection happen before transport.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.41 step 14 and §9.3.19 step 5: Dispatch normalized zoned and year-month formatting.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Rebuilds typed values and forwards normalized options to formatters. Separate arithmetic/conversion branches share the dispatcher without changing their ownership.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §13.35 step 29 and §6.5.1 steps 1.c and 3.a: Bridge parsed zoned fields and resolve local requests.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Packages parsed zoned fields and dispatches normalized resolution through day_boundary or from_local_with_offset. Plain parse branches likewise delegate. No JS options or full grammar equivalence claim.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.5.3 steps 4–6: Decode exact instant, zone and calendar into a typed value.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Validates an exact Instant, resolves the wire zone and calendar, and builds the native value for later operations.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.5.10 step 8, §6.5.9 step 9 and §6.3.45 step 6: Dispatch typed zoned operations.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Uses typed owners for add/subtract, difference, round, day boundary and hours-in-day after decoding normalized parameters. JS option and receiver logic remain separate.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §7.3.20 steps 11–12: Decode a prepared date or zoned anchor.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Wire only. Discriminates two normalized relative anchors and reconstructs the typed values. Public relativeTo preparation and its observable side effects belong upstream.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §7.3.21 steps 12.f and 13.h: Delegate total to its typed relative anchor.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Selects plain or zoned total based on the prepared anchor, forwarding the exact duration and requested unit.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §7.3.20 steps 27–28: Delegate rounding to its typed relative anchor.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Selects date or zoned rounding and forwards all resolved units, increment and mode. Relative arithmetic remains in the typed implementation.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §7.2.3 steps 12–13: Delegate duration comparison to its typed relative anchor.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Forwards the two validated durations to date or zoned comparison. Comparison endpoint arithmetic remains in the typed owner.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §4.5.8 steps 1.a–1.f and 2.b: Preserve clock bounds through numeric transport.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Finite integral inputs are cast to typed integers. Saturation outside i128 preserves subsequent constrain/reject outcome since those values exceed all clock component bounds. PlainTime::from_fields performs final regulation.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.2 steps 7–13: Transport exact clock nanoseconds and optional field parts.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Local projection. Emits exact decimal text, optionally with decomposed hour/minute/second and ordered subsecond fields from an already validated PlainTime.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §4.5.8 step 3 and §4.3.16 steps 11–12: Dispatch normalized plain-time requests.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Forwards parsing, regulation, formatting, add/subtract, difference and rounding to their typed owners. Wire clock snapshots preserve transport shape only.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §3.5.14 step 6 and §5.5.15 step 6: Route typed plain date and date-time difference.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Rebuilds typed values and routes add/subtract or until/since to their owners. Plain date-time round forwards time-unit requests or selects day rounding with increment one.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §8.3.11 steps 13 and 15 and §8.5.8 step 7.a: Round before looking up the format offset.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Mixed. Derives a precision quantum, rounds exact epoch nanoseconds, and validates the result before named-zone offset lookup. Delegates final text formatting and uses trunc because the value is already rounded.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §8.5.9 step 4 and §8.3.11 step 15: Dispatch typed Instant difference and formatting.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegated. Decodes Instant requests and forwards parsing, formatting, add/subtract, round, and difference to typed owners. The quantum wire form validates a divisor and translates it to a typed unit/increment pair.

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.2 steps 14–16 and §3.5.9 steps 1–3: Route normalized requests and ISO record operations.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Mixed. Operation allowlist and status codes are transport. The ISO branches use typed epoch/calendar conversions and implement day displacement by exact integer addition. Other branches call operation-specific owners.

validation.result: 7 Bazel targets passed in the same validation batch.
